macro.headline: RBA in Focus: Persistent Inflation and Geopolitical Tensions Shape Cautious Outlook
themes: Geopolitical Risk Premium: Ongoing conflicts in the Middle East and Eastern Europe keep energy prices firm and bolster safe-haven demand for gold, increasing market volatility.
RBA Rate Stance: Market on edge for the RBA's June meeting (June 3rd), with 'higher for longer' sentiment or potential further tightening still possible given sticky inflation data.
Consumer Squeeze Intensifies: High interest rates and persistent cost-of-living pressures continue to weigh heavily on consumer confidence and discretionary spending, impacting domestic demand.
